discussion:
I need to correct two issues in the MultilineContinuationError documentation entry in Doc/library/configparser.rst:
1. The parenthetical "(a line beginning with whitespace)" is too broad — the parser checks that indentation is strictly greater than the preceding option, and blank/comment lines are handled separately.
2. `:attr:`!allow_no_value`` incorrectly implies it's a public attribute; it's a constructor option.

I'll patch the exception description to be accurate.

operation.new:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a non-blank, non-comment
   line whose indentation is greater than that of the preceding option)
   follows an option that has no value.  This condition is only possible
   when the ``allow_no_value`` constructor option is ``True``.  Subclass
   of :exc:`ParsingError`.
operation.old:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a line beginning with
   whitespace) follows an option that has no value.  This condition is
   only possible when :attr:`!allow_no_value` is ``True``.  Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.
